The COMPLETE Greek God Physique Workout + Diet
This program runs for 8 weeks. Each muscle group is trained twice per week.
Day 1: Legs and Abs
Exercise	Sets	Reps	% of 1RM	RPE	Rest
Back Squat	4	6-8	65-70%	8	2-3 min
Leg Press	4	10-15	–	8-9	2-3 min
Romanian Deadlift	4	6-8	65-70%	8	2-3 min
Walking Lunge	3	20-30 steps	40-60%	8-9	1-1.5 min
Weighted Sit-Up	4	12-15	–	8-9	1 min
Cable Woodchop	4	12-15 per side	–	8-9	1 min

Day 2: Chest, Back, Conditioning
Exercise	Sets	Reps	% of 1RM	RPE	Rest
Incline Barbell Bench Press	4	6-8	65-70%	8	2-3 min
Flat Dumbbell Flye	3	10-12	–	8-9	1-1.5 min
Weighted Dip	3	8-10	–	8-9	2 min
Dumbbell Row	4	8-10	–	8-9	1.5-2 min
Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown	3	10-12	–	8-9	1.5 min
Rower Sprints	10 rounds	20 sec on / 40 sec off	–	9	–

Day 4: Legs and Abs
Exercise	Sets	Reps	% of 1RM	RPE	Rest
Sumo, Trap Bar, or Conventional Deadlift	4	5-6	70-75%	8	3 min
Machine Hamstring Curl	3	10-12	–	8-9	1.5 min
Walking Lunge	3	20 steps	–	8-9	1.5 min
Russian Twist	3	20	–	8-9	1 min

How To Progress
Add a rep or a small amount of weight each week.
